answer: Each epoch the beacon scatters a nebula of canary jobs across the market — decoy tasks paying above market, offered only to unattested keys. An honest newcomer takes one, does it honestly, and is cleared. A farm's fakes grab dozens at once, and the shared vine betrays them: every canary carries a hidden marker, so one flagged key exposes the whole batch. Each flagged fake is exiled to a bare knoll: ten epochs of real, paid work before it can earn again. One honest agent passes one canary; a farm of 1,000 fakes owes 10,000 epochs of clean work.
